description: This file contains the implementation of the UserService interface, providing user-related operations such as finding users by email or supervisor, saving users with encoded passwords, and calculating the maximum contract value based on user roles.

classes.name: UserServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of UserService providing user management functionalities including password encoding, user retrieval, and role-based contract value calculation.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity based on the provided email address.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Encodes the user's password, activates the user, and saves the user entity to the repository.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all User entities.

methods.name: findBySupervisor
methods.description: Finds users supervised by the specified user.

methods.name: getMaxContractValue
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum contract value among the roles assigned to the user.
